child.pronouns: How should we refer to the hero? (optional)

photos.title: Upload 1 to 3 photos
photos.subtitle: We use them to draw a character that looks like your child. The photos themselves are not printed in the book.
photos.tip3: Only your child in the photo
photos.tip4: No sunglasses or hats covering the face
photos.consentText: I am this child's parent or legal guardian, or have their permission, and I agree that StoryNido may use these photos only to create their story. Photos are stored encrypted and automatically deleted after 30 days; I can delete them sooner at any time.
photos.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB

reasons.unsupported_format: We couldn't open the file. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
reasons.low_resolution: The photo is too small. Use a higher-quality one.
reasons.no_face: We couldn't find a face. Use a photo where their face is clearly visible.
reasons.multiple_faces: There is more than one person. Use a photo with only your child.
reasons.face_too_small: The face looks too small. Get closer or crop the photo.
reasons.too_dark: It is too dark. Try a photo with more light.
reasons.too_bright: It is too bright. Avoid flash or direct sunlight.
reasons.blurry: It is blurry. Try a sharper one.

photos.tooLarge: The photo is larger than 15 MB.
photos.badType: That format is not supported. Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
photos.limit: You already have 3 photos. Delete one to upload another.
photos.needOne: Upload at least one valid photo to continue.
photos.uploadError: We couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.
